checks.after: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, with achievements in following his predecessor’s footsteps and expanding the realm that surpass those of the great Earl of the West.
checks.reason: 繼武闡廣之功 is achievement in following earlier footsteps and expanding, not ‘martial expansion’, and 有高西伯 is surpassing, not rivaling, the Earl of the West. The text matches the reviewed EN, and no identity is assigned.

checks.after: It is fitting to reduce and abolish the parks and settle the displaced on them.
checks.reason: 省罷 is reduce and abolish, 宜 is ‘it is fitting’, and 以業流人 gives the displaced a livelihood on that land. The current EN drops the abolition and the advisory modality; the replacement is faithful.

checks.after: Even Wei and Jin, though the Way faded, still did not cut the people by as much as seven or eight tenths; those farming with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people, those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state, and the people were secure and all rejoiced.
checks.reason: 削百姓不至於七八 limits what was taken from the people to short of seven or eight tenths, set against Huang’s 8/10 and 7/10 in s0110–s0111 and the 6/4 and even splits. ‘Below seven or eight tenths’ reverses this; the fix and the restored 官田 and 百姓安之 are faithful.

checks.after: Even Wei and Jin, though an age of fading Way, still did not cut into the people as far as seven or eight tenths; those who farmed with official oxen gave six parts to the state and four to the people; those with private oxen on official land split evenly with the state; the people were secure and all rejoiced.
checks.reason: The literal has the same reversal of the 不至於七八 share. ‘Did not cut into the people as far as seven or eight tenths’ keeps the exaction direction, and the rest of the literal is unchanged.

checks.after: Now households approach a hundred thousand, crowded against the capital; I fear this will soon become a deep harm to the state. Divide their brothers and lineage and move them to western border cities, soothe them with kindness and restrain them with law, so they do not scatter among settled people and learn the state's strength and weakness.
checks.reason: The EN omits the speaker’s fear 恐方將為國家深害 and the dispersal restriction 使不得散在居人, and merges 撫之以恩，檢之以法. The replacement restores them faithfully, with Feng Yu still the speaker.

checks.after: Now households approach a hundred thousand, crowded narrow against the capital; I fear this will soon become a deep harm to the state; it is fitting to divide their brothers and lineage and move them to western border cities, soothe them with kindness and restrain them by law, so they do not scatter among settled people and learn the state's strength and weakness.
checks.reason: 檢之以法 is restraining or regulating them by law; ‘inspect them with law’ is a definite mistranslation. Changing only that phrase is faithful and keeps the fear and the closing restrictions.

checks.after: Now the central plain is not yet pacified and stores ought to be enlarged; official posts are numerous and idlers not few; when one man does not plow, hunger is suffered through the year.
checks.reason: 歲受其饑 is hunger suffered through the year because one man fails to plow; ‘the year receives his hunger’ wrongly personifies 歲. The replacement matches the pending reviewed EN wording.

checks.after: Those with world-surpassing strategy and talent matching the age's needs may be placed in posts as required.
checks.reason: 經略出世 is world-surpassing strategy, 才稱時求 is talent meeting the age’s needs, and 置之列位 is placing them in posts. The current EN drops two of these; the replacement restores all three.

checks.after: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for counsel as for water; therefore men fully offer even rustic woodcutter counsel, offending yet not hiding.
checks.reason: 聖性, the 若渴 simile, 故 causation, 芻蕘 as humble rustic counsel, and 有犯無隱 (withholding nothing despite offense) are flattened or dropped in the current EN; the replacement restores them faithfully.

checks.after: Your Highness is sage in nature, broad and clear, thirsting for words as for water; therefore men fully offer even the counsel of woodcutters and fuel-gatherers, offending yet not hiding.
checks.reason: 人盡芻蕘 alludes to fully offering the counsel of woodcutters and fuel-gatherers, not exhausting actual firewood and grass; the replacement fixes the literal and keeps 有犯無隱.

checks.after: The responsible officials memorialized that they spoke demonic words offending superiors and brought them to law; Your Highness, merciful and broad in acceptance, pardoned their capital offense yet still demoted, barred, and excluded them from court.
checks.reason: The EN drops 奏, 犯上, 至之于法, 慈弘苞納, and the separate 削黜/禁錮/不齒於朝 penalties. The replacement restores them and keeps the charge with the responsible officials, not the narrator.

checks.after: To punish remonstrating ministers while seeking straight words is like going north to reach Yue; how can there be any gain!
checks.reason: 豈有得邪 is a rhetorical denial that anything can be gained, and the current EN drops it; the replacement restores the clause without changing the Yue comparison or the speaker.
